notes: 'of God' answers to no morpheme — יִרְאָה already holds 'fear' and its suffix 'thy' — so it is added under rule 30, corroborated but not decided by the ASV italic (rule 7).
The fronted question copula 'Is' goes to הֲ in a verbless clause, on the precedent of rule 17's הֲלוֹא and rule 50's 'Is there no balm in Gilead'; the predicate keeps only its own noun.
The waw takes the italicized 'And': a present conjunction licenses the written connective whatever the italic (rules 14, 7).
